eat-drink-george-town.name: Eat Drink George Town
eat-drink-george-town.short_description: Hungry for Georgetown's greatest hits? Simply Enak's most-loved Penang tour starts as the sun sets and Georgetown comes alive. Three cultures' evening delights.
eat-drink-george-town.full_description:
Hungry for Georgetown's greatest hits?

Our most-loved Penang tour starts as the sun sets and Georgetown comes alive. We'll guide you through three cultures' evening delights: sizzling satay, the best samosas in Malaysia, and char kway teow fresh off the wok at Chew Jetty.

You'll watch roti jala being handcrafted like golden lace, hear the secret society tales and forbidden history that shaped these streets, then toast the evening with a Junglebird, Malaysia's own cocktail.

Every dish and vendor has a story. Dietary needs? No problem :)

penang-street-food.name: Penang Street Food
penang-street-food.short_description: What makes Penang the "food capital" of Malaysia? Simply Enak will guide you through the cultural fusion that created dishes you'll only find here. At Chowrasta Market, we'll dare you to try kopitiam "Ngor Ka Sai".
penang-street-food.full_description:
What makes Penang the "food capital" of Malaysia?

We'll guide you through the cultural fusion that created dishes you'll only find here. At Chowrasta Market, we'll dare you to try kopitiam "Ngor Ka Sai", signature nutmeg pickles and dodol.

You'll watch a master handcraft popiah skin, and taste legendary Asam Laksa balancing sweet, sour and savoury. We'll share Peranakan culture through colourful kuey, explore temples and street art, and you'll leave with the history and culture behind Penang's most famous flavours.

Every dish and vendor has a story. Dietary needs? No problem :)
